statement: Implement the exact execution/completeness adapter that lets N106 dispatch only N220 survivors by secondary N230 filtered rank while N104 continues to certify the complete pre-N220 canonical old-rank domain.

scope.population: every exact FULL178 (row_id,d,e) stratum after the audited N220 necessary cut
scope.field_or_model: N104 canonical old-rank completeness / N106 stratum-local execution / N230 secondary filtered survivor rank
scope.quantifiers: all old canonical terminal ranks are disposed exactly once as audited N220 rejection or processed filtered survivor
scope.required_output: source-locked per-stratum partition certificate, random-access filtered work-unit identity, exact-cover verifier, and old-rank replay without materializing rejected or survivor populations

contract.rejected_disposition: N220_REJECTED is discharged by audited N220 predicate plus audited N230 old-rank disposition adapter; rejected terminals receive no Picard leaf execution
contract.survivor_disposition: every filtered rank in [0,filtered_terminal_count) must be covered exactly once by a COMPLETE execution work unit and replay bijectively to one old canonical rank
contract.cover_rule: sorted COMPLETE filtered intervals are pairwise disjoint, first lo=0, adjacent hi=next lo, final hi=filtered_terminal_count; empty survivor strata require filtered_terminal_count=0 and no survivor work unit
contract.old_domain_release_rule: only after the exact N220 partition certificate passes and filtered survivor cover is COMPLETE may the stratum be marked fully disposed relative to N104; this is not numerical Picard success unless every survivor leaf itself has an exact registered numerical disposition

notes: N240 is an adapter, not a new mathematical pruning claim.
N240 must never reinterpret the filtered rank as N104 canonical rank.
No heavy compute, FULL178 numerical completion, theorem/receiver/endpoint, existence/nonexistence, or merge credit is authorized.
